text:
jamie: Heads-up: canary promo is failing on 3/4 integration checks, looks like an artifact cache metadata race during image fetch. holding rollout for now.

deploy-bot: Deploybot: promotion halted for canary rollout 2026-03-20T10:02Z due to job failure (canary-42). See CI job 7842.
morgan: I saw flakes on the runner logs, 'cache metadata mismatch' when pulling layer index. re-run gives green sometimes.
nina: repro steps? I can ssh into the staging runner and inspect /var/lib/dep-cache.
sre-ops: don't make changes to runners yet, let's collect logs first. if it's a metadata race we might need to pin behaviour in deploybot rather than fix nodes immediately.
qa-ingest: failing test is integration/payment-end-to-end, timeout on webhook deliver. logs show checksum mismatch on artifact that contains the webhook test fixture.
jamie: proposal: rollback canary to previous image tag (immutable digest) and abort promotion. then run isolated reruns to reproduce. thoughts?
morgan: +1 to rollback. If we promote a bad canary we'll cause alerts. How long to rollback? deploy-bot can do quick rollback if we allow manual override.
release-manager: we have a change window until 14:00 UTC. rollback is safe within window but need release notes updated. I'll mark release blocked in the tracker.
deploy-bot: Deploybot: received manual rollback request for canary-42 -> rolling back to canary-41. ETA ~3m.
sre-ops: while rollback happens, can we start a dedicated CI run with cache disabled for the image build? Command: ```CI=true ./scripts/ci/run_integration.sh --no-cache --job payment-end-to-end```
nina: running that now on isolated runner r-staging-9. grabbing diagnostic artifacts to /tmp/ci-dumps. will paste link when done.
qa-ingest: if the no-cache run fails consistently, we know it's cache corruption. if it passes, it's likely a transient race. either way we should avoid promoting until we land a mitigation.
morgan: we should also consider a short-term deploybot policy change: prefer immutable digests for promoting artifacts when available, fallback to tag only if digest resolution succeeds within timeout. small config change.
jamie: agreed. can someone open a quick PR in infra/deploy-config with that policy and a default 5s digest-resolve timeout? we can cherry-pick to prod after rollback.
sre-ops: i'll open a draft PR and run it in staging. also scheduling a patch to runner agent to add a retry on cache index fetch (3x with jitter).
release-manager: logging decision: hold promotion, rollback in progress, policy PR and runner retry patch targeted for hotfix this afternoon. I'll notify stakeholders and update release notes section 'blocked: artifact cache race'.
deploy-bot: Deploybot: rollback to canary-41 succeeded. Canary group is now on canary-41. Promotion remains blocked.
jamie: thanks. nina, paste link to diagnostic tarball when available. morgan, want to own the config PR?
morgan: I'll take the config PR. tagging @jamie for review.
nina: diag upload: https://internal.ci/artifacts/ci-dumps/canary-42-cache-dump-3332101234.tar.gz 
qa-ingest: confirmed: no-cache run passed locally on r-staging-9. suggests cache race.
sre-ops: will start a fleet check for nodes that reported checksum mismatches. also incrementally roll the runner agent to add fetch retry.
release-manager: I've added a note to the release tracker and set status to 'blocked - rollback done - investigating'. Will convene a 30m sync at 11:00 UTC to triage if needed.
jamie: perfect. when the config PR is ready, let's canary it on a subset of deploybot instances before flipping globally. no further promotes until PR + runner patch validated. :white_check_mark:

(reactions: :eyes: from release-manager, :thumbsup: from morgan)
